## Summary

A one-paragraph description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Motivation

Why is this feature valuable? Which use case does it enable?

## Proposed Solution

How do you think this should be implemented? Describe the API, storage
changes, or algorithm at a high level.

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider, and why did you reject them?

## Additional Context

Links to papers, reference implementations, or related issues.
